headline: PAL reconstruction covers drawing, state and lookup helpers
summary: Deadlocked contributors landed PAL drawing, point transforms, smoothing, object access and state helpers, plus larger lookup batches. These are matching reconstructions of existing game behaviour, meaning the C compiles to the original bytes. Contributors can also extract a disc stored outside the checkout by supplying its path (#56).
highlights: Merged work includes 30 PAL functions (#54), seventeen hash lookups (#72), five lookup/state functions (#74) and 22 game functions (#75).
The opened NTSC-U draft claims 45 verified functions but still needs PAL mapping before merge because PAL retail inputs were unavailable locally (#71).
Further PAL batches remain open rather than landed: 21 functions (#55), six helpers (#77), 53 resident functions (#78) and one function (#79).
Issue #73 distinguishes five matching PAL functions from three unmatched drafts and warns that generated translation ranges are not decompiled-function counts.
